mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a garage conversion and a new backyard office, and which is right for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion repurposes an existing structure, often proving more cost-effective and quicker to complete than new construction, as it utilizes existing foundations and walls. A new backyard office, however, offers complete design flexibility from the ground up, allowing for custom dimensions, specific layouts, and integration of amenities not possible within existing garage footprints. The right choice depends on your budget, desired level of customization, and the condition and size of your current garage. Consider your long-term needs for space and functionality before deciding.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion reuses an existing structure, while a new backyard office offers complete design flexibility. Your budget, customization needs, and existing garage condition will determine the best option.
